```{r}
# Fisher combine 

fisher_combined <- res_wo_atcopia[, .(
  n_studies   = .N,
  fisher_stat = -2 * sum(log(p_wald)),
  mean_beta   = mean(beta),
  mean_af     = mean(af)
), by = .(rs, chr, ps)]

fisher_combined[, p_fisher := pchisq(fisher_stat, df = 2 * n_studies, lower.tail = FALSE)]

# Plot
par(mar = c(5, 5, 4, 2))

snp_table <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/10_metadata/a_priori.genes_with_coordinates.txt", sep=";", header=T)

# Get SNPs to highlight
snps_to_highlight <- NULL
if (!is.null(snp_table)) {
  hits <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:nrow(snp_table), function(i) {
    fisher_combined[fisher_combined$chr == as.integer(snp_table$chr[i]) &
                    fisher_combined$ps > snp_table$start[i] &
                    fisher_combined$ps < snp_table$end[i], ]
  }))
  snps_to_highlight <- hits$rs
}


# QQ plot
par(mar = c(5, 5, 2, 2))

# Manhattan plot
par(mar = c(5, 5, 4, 2))
manhattan(fisher_combined,
          chr = "chr", bp = "ps", snp = "rs", p = "p_fisher",
          col = c("#1A1A1A", "#838B8B"),
          genomewideline = FALSE, suggestiveline = FALSE,
          highlight = snps_to_highlight,
          ylim = c(0, 80),
          cex.axis = 1, cex.lab = 1,
          xlab = "Chromosome",
          ylab = expression(-log[10](P)))
  
```
## Make a plottly plot 
```{r}
make_manhattan <- function(input, threshold = 2, title = "Manhattan Plot", 
                           output_file = "manhattan.html", gene_coords = NULL){
  
  if(is.character(input) && file.exists(input)){
    cat("Reading file...\n")
    gwas_data <- read.delim(input, sep = "\t")
  } else {
    gwas_data <- input
  }
  n_snps <- nrow(gwas_data)
  bonferroni <- -log10(0.05 / n_snps)
  gwas_filtered <- gwas_data[-log10(gwas_data$p_wald) > threshold, ]
  if(!is.null(gene_coords)){
    cat("Annotating genes...\n")
    gwas_dt2 <- as.data.table(gwas_filtered)
    gene_dt2 <- as.data.table(gene_coords)
    # Join SNPs to genes using exact gene boundaries. Show ID only if the gene falls into 
    annotated <- gene_dt2[gwas_dt2, 
                          .(chr = i.chr, ps = i.ps, p_wald = i.p_wald, 
                            af = i.af, tair_id = V10),
                          on = .(V1 = chr, V4 <= ps, V5 >= ps),
                          mult = "first"]
    annotated[is.na(tair_id), tair_id := "."]
    gwas_filtered <- as.data.frame(annotated)
  }
  mh <- manhattanly(
    gwas_filtered,
    chr = "chr",
    bp = "ps",
    p = "p_wald",
    snp = "ps",
    annotation1 = "af",
    annotation2 = if(!is.null(gene_coords)) "tair_id" else NULL,
    suggestiveline = FALSE,
    genomewideline = bonferroni,# Bonferroni line
    title = title
    )
  htmlwidgets::saveWidget(mh, file = output_file)
  cat(paste("\nSaved to", output_file))
  mh <- mh %>% plotly::layout(yaxis = list(range = c(2, 100)))
  return(mh)
}


fisher_combined[, p_wald := p_fisher]
fisher_combined[, af := mean_af]

make_manhattan(fisher_combined, threshold = 2, title = "average_ddm1_zscale_maf005_with_k_families", output_file = "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/blup_gwas/blups_ddm1_family_average/log2/with_K/average_ddm1_zscale_maf005_with_k_families.html", gene_coords = genes_and_tes)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
gene_annotation <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/tair10/TAIR10_GFF3_genes.gff") %>% filter(V3=="gene" |V3=="transposable_element_gene"  )
gene_annotation$gene_id <- gsub(";.*", "",gene_annotation$V9)
gene_annotation$gene_id <- gsub("ID=", "", gene_annotation$gene_id)
gene_annotation <- gene_annotation %>% dplyr::select(V1,V3,V4,V5,gene_id)
plot_data <- left_join(all_res, gene_annotation, by=c("study"="gene_id"))
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

plot_sub <- plot_data[p_wald < 0.001]

ggplot(plot_sub, aes(x = ps_cum, y = te_pos_cum, color = -log10(p_wald))) +
  geom_point(size = 1, shape = 15, stroke = 0) +
 scale_color_gradientn(
  name = "-log10(p)",
  colours = c("grey90", "blue", "red", "yellow"),
  values = scales::rescale(c(2, 5, 7, 10)),
  limits = c(2, 10),
  oob = scales::squish
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = chr_breaks$start, color = "grey70", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = chr_breaks$start, color = "grey70", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.3) +
  labs(x = "SNP genomic position", y = "Gene position") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  coord_equal()+ylim(0, max(plot_data$te_pos_cum))

```



```{r}

# TEs with most significant associations
# Find TEs with most associations (horizontal lines)
top_tes <- plot_data %>% 
  count(study, TE_num, sort = TRUE) %>% 
  head(20)

ggplot(plot_data,
       aes(x = ps_cum/1e6, y = TE_num, color = -log10(p_wald))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.9, size = 0.8, shape = 16) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colours = c("#FAF8F1", "#C5CAE9", "#5C6BC0", "#2845D6", "#1A3263"),
    values = scales::rescale(c(3, 5, 7, 9, 10)),
    limits = c(3, 10), oob = scales::squish,
    name = expression(-log[10](p))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = chr_axis$center/1e6,
                     labels = chr_axis$chr) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = top_tes$TE_num,       # only label top TEs
    labels = top_tes$study,
    expand = c(0, 0.5)) +
  labs(x = "Chromosome", y = "Transposon position") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 4),  # show TE names
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank())
```
